ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Foods/Feeding PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.

2. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Paper burning to ash

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather ENVIRONMENT.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals ENVIRONMENT.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Home ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Home ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Home ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Home ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Home ENVIRONMENT.

7. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.

9. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for the teeth PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for the teeth PRACTICES.

11. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. watt (W)

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

13. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

14. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying : OUR SCHOOL? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about : OUR SCHOOL.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on : OUR SCHOOL.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for : OUR SCHOOL.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to : OUR SCHOOL.

16. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Sound ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Light ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Care CARE AND SAFETY and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Safety CARE AND SAFETY and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Myself ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain : OUR SCHOOL and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
